correctness.rationale: PASS: Partition every palindromic scattered subsequence by j=0,1,2,3 copies of the symbol 1. Zero-only contributes m+1; one-one contributes h+1 via union of three initial length intervals; two-one words 0^i 1 0^j 1 0^i form three down-closed rectangles whose union is a base (x+1)(b+c+1) plus exactly E excess lattice points. Three-one words 0^i1 0^j1 0^j1 0^i contribute (x+1)(y+1). The resulting formula m+2+h+(x+1)(b+c+1)+(x+1)(y+1)+E covers all zero gaps. Symmetric case a=d=u,b=c=v reduces to 3uv+5u+6v+4, strictly concave in integer u at fixed s=u+v, uniquely maximized by u=floor(s/2). Independently enumerated all distinct subsequence strings for 495 gap tuples (up to 8 zeros) and checked the symmetric extremum through s=79. Finite tests are corroboration; case partition proves unrestricted zero-gap identity.
